name: youtube
description: YouTube Data API v3 integration: inspect channel, retrieve channel metadata, list uploaded videos, and upload videos using Google OAuth.
author: AgentForge

capabilities.description: Inspect the authenticated user's YouTube channel, upload playlist ID, and subscriber/video statistics

outputs.name: hasChannel
outputs.description: Whether the Google account has a created YouTube channel

outputs.name: channel
outputs.description: Channel details, statistics, and uploads playlist ID

capabilities.description: Retrieve channel metadata for the authenticated user, or lookup a specific channel by ID or handle

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: Whether the requested channel was found

capabilities.description: List videos from the user's uploads playlist or a specified playlist with pagination

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.description: Number of videos to return (1-50, default 10)

inputs.name: pageToken
inputs.description: Optional pagination token for next page

inputs.name: playlistId
inputs.description: Optional playlist ID (defaults to user's uploads playlist)

outputs.name: nextPageToken
outputs.description: Token for next page if available

outputs.name: prevPageToken
outputs.description: Token for previous page if available

capabilities.description: Upload a video file to YouTube with title, description, tags, and visibility status. Requires explicit operator approval.

inputs.name: filePath
inputs.description: Absolute path to video file on local disk

inputs.name: categoryId
inputs.description: Numeric YouTube category ID (default '22' People & Blogs)

inputs.name: fileSha256
inputs.description: Expected SHA-256 hash of file for tamper verification

inputs.name: fileSize
inputs.description: Expected file size in bytes for tamper verification

outputs.name: videoUrl
outputs.description: Direct URL to the uploaded video

outputs.name: channelId
outputs.description: Channel ID video was uploaded to

integrations.name: google-oauth
integrations.setupInstructions: Connect via 'agentforge auth youtube' or the Manager dashboard to authorize YouTube scopes.

permissions.approvalReason: Uploading a video will publish content to your YouTube channel. Explicit operator approval is required.

verificationSteps: Run channel-inspect to verify channel metadata retrieval
Run video-list to verify uploads playlist listing
Authorize upload scope with 'agentforge auth youtube --upload'
Run video-upload with operator approval to publish video
